title: Synthesis and Anticancer Evaluation of New Indole-Based Tyrphostin Derivatives and Their (p-Cymene)dichloridoruthenium(II) Complexes.
authors: Oberhuber, Natalie; Ghosh, Hindole; Nitzsche, Bianca; Dandawate, Prasad; Hopfner, Michael; Schobert, Rainer; Biersack, Bernhard
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吲哚类酪氨酸激酶抑制剂及其钌配合物的抗癌活性，仅涉及小分子-激酶对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: New N-alkylindole-substituted 2-(pyrid-3-yl)-acrylonitriles with putative kinase inhibitory activity and their (p-cymene)Ru(II) piano-stool complexes were prepared and tested for their antiproliferative efficacy in various cancer models. Some of the indole-based derivatives inhibited tumor cell proliferation at (sub-)micromolar concentrations with IC(50) values below those of the clinically relevant multikinase inhibitors gefitinib and sorafenib, which served as positive controls. A focus was set on the investigation of drug mechanisms in HCT-116 p53-knockout colon cancer cells in order to evaluate the dependence of the test compounds on p53. Colony formation assays as well as experiments with tumor spheroids confirmed the excellent antineoplastic efficacy of the new derivatives. Their mode of action included an induction of apoptotic caspase-3/7 activity and ROS formation, as well as anti-angiogenic properties. Docking calculations with EGFR and VEGFR-2 identified the two 3-aryl-2-(pyrid-3-yl)acrylonitrile derivatives 2a and 2b as potential kinase inhibitors with a preferential activity against the VEGFR-2 tyrosine kinase. Forthcoming studies will further unveil the underlying mode of action of the promising new derivatives as well as their suitability as an urgently needed novel approach in cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 制备了具有潜在激酶抑制活性的新型N-烷基吲哚取代的2-(吡啶-3-基)-丙烯腈及其(p-伞花烃)Ru(II)钢琴凳型配合物，并在多种癌症模型中测试了其抗增殖效果。部分吲哚类衍生物在（亚）微摩尔浓度下抑制肿瘤细胞增殖，其IC(50)值低于作为阳性对照的临床相关多激酶抑制剂吉非替尼和索拉非尼。重点研究了HCT-116 p53敲除结肠癌细胞中的药物机制，以评估测试化合物对p53的依赖性。集落形成实验及肿瘤球体实验证实了新衍生物优异的抗肿瘤效果。其作用机制包括诱导凋亡性caspase-3/7活性和ROS生成，以及抗血管生成特性。与EGFR和VEGFR-2的对接计算将两种3-芳基-2-(吡啶-3-基)丙烯腈衍生物2a和2b鉴定为潜在的激酶抑制剂，优先作用于VEGFR-2酪氨酸激酶。未来的研究将进一步揭示这些有前景的新衍生物的潜在作用机制，以及它们作为癌症治疗中迫切需求的新方法的适用性。
